mapper.select: SELECT c.company_code, c.company_name, d.division_code, d.division_name FROM company c LEFT JOIN division d ON c.company_code = d.company_code WHERE c.company_code = #{company_code} ORDER BY c.company_code, d.division_code

SELECT #{search_type} AS search_type, a.company_code AS company_code, a.company_name AS company_name, a.company_name_eng AS company_name_eng, a.company_name_loc AS company_name_loc, a.officer_name AS officer_name, a.officer_name_eng AS officer_name_eng, a.officer_phone_no AS officer_phone_no, a.officer_email AS officer_email, a.business_no AS business_no, a.com_phone_no AS com_phone_no, a.com_fax_no AS com_fax_no, a.zip_code AS zip_code, a.address AS address, a.address_eng AS address_eng, COALESCE(NULLIF(a.company_use_yn, ''), 'Y') AS company_use_yn, a.ctc_decision_only_yn AS ctc_decision_only_yn, a.co_certified_exporter_yn AS co_certified_exporter_yn, a.certification_type AS certification_type, a.certification_no AS certification_no, a.material_use_yn AS material_use_yn, co_bf.option_value AS bf_company_option, co_ru.option_value AS ru_company_option, co_ma.option_value AS basic_aging_period
FROM company a LEFT OUTER JOIN company_option co_bf ON a.company_code = co_bf.company_code AND co_bf.option_code = 'BF' LEFT OUTER JOIN company_option co_ru ON a.company_code = co_ru.company_code AND co_ru.option_code = 'RU' LEFT OUTER JOIN company_option co_ma ON a.company_code = co_ma.company_code AND co_ma.option_code = 'MA' WHERE a.company_code = #{company_code}
mapper.update: UPDATE company SET company_name = #{company_name}, company_name_eng = #{company_name_eng}, company_name_loc = #{company_name_loc}, officer_name = #{officer_name}, officer_name_eng = #{officer_name_eng}, officer_phone_no = #{officer_phone_no}, officer_email = #{officer_email}, business_no = #{business_no}, com_phone_no = #{com_phone_no}, com_fax_no = #{com_fax_no}, zip_code = #{zip_code}, address = #{address}, address_eng = #{address_eng}, company_use_yn = #{company_use_yn}, ctc_decision_only_yn = #{ctc_decision_only_yn}, update_date = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, update_by = #{update_by} WHERE company_code = #{company_code}

UPDATE company SET co_certified_exporter_yn = #{co_certified_exporter_yn}, certification_type = #{certification_type}, certification_no = #{certification_no}, update_date = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, update_by = #{update_by} WHERE company_code = #{company_code}
mapper.select: SELECT #{search_type} AS search_type, d.company_code, d.division_code, d.division_name, d.division_name_eng, d.business_no, d.division_phone_no, d.division_fax_no, d.division_type, d.zip_code, d.address, d.address_eng, d.status, d.create_date, d.create_by, d.update_date, d.update_by FROM division d WHERE d.company_code = #{company_code} AND d.division_code = #{p_param_code}
mapper.update: UPDATE division SET division_name = #{division_name}, division_name_eng = #{division_name_eng}, business_no = #{business_no}, division_phone_no = #{division_phone_no}, division_fax_no = #{division_fax_no}, division_type = #{division_type}, zip_code = #{zip_code}, address = #{address}, address_eng = #{address_eng}, status = #{status}, update_date = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, update_by = #{update_by} WHERE company_code = #{company_code} AND division_code = #{division_code}
mapper.select: SELECT c.company_code AS target_code ,c.company_name AS target_name ,c.com_rvc_rate AS rvc_rate ,c.com_de_minimis_rate AS de_minimis_rate FROM company c WHERE c.company_code = #{company_code}
SELECT d.division_code AS target_code ,d.division_name AS target_name ,d.div_rvc_rate AS rvc_rate ,d.div_de_minimis_rate AS de_minimis_rate FROM division d WHERE d.company_code = #{company_code}
SELECT f.fta_code AS target_code ,f.fta_name AS target_name ,f.com_rvc_rate AS rvc_rate ,f.com_de_minimis_rate AS de_minimis_rate FROM fta_master f WHERE f.company_code = #{company_code}
SELECT sign_file_name, real_file FROM signature WHERE company_code = #{company_code} AND emp_no = #{emp_no} AND end_date is null ORDER BY update_date DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT a.user_id , a.company_code , a.dept_name , a.emp_no , a.name_kor , a.name_eng , a.name_local , a.position_name , a.position_name_eng , a.email , a.cell_phone_no , a.office_phone_no , a.fax_no , a.status , a.default_language , b.sign_file_name , COALESCE(end_date, '99991231') AS end_date , CASE WHEN b.emp_no IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS signature_yn , CASE WHEN b.emp_no IS NULL THEN '' ELSE '서명권자' END AS signature_text FROM user_info a LEFT OUTER JOIN signature b ON a.company_code = b.company_code AND a.emp_no = b.emp_no AND b.end_date is null WHERE a.company_code = #{company_code}

SELECT a.user_id , a.company_code , a.dept_name , a.emp_no , a.name_kor , a.name_eng , a.name_local , a.position_name , a.position_name_eng , a.email , a.cell_phone_no , a.office_phone_no , a.fax_no , a.status , a.default_language , b.seq , b.sign_file_name , start_date , NVL(end_date, '99991231') AS end_date , CASE WHEN b.emp_no IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS signature_yn , CASE WHEN b.emp_no IS NULL THEN '' ELSE '서명권자' END AS signature_text FROM user_info a LEFT OUTER JOIN signature b ON a.company_code = b.company_code AND a.emp_no = b.emp_no WHERE a.company_code = #{company_code} AND a.user_id = #{param_user_id} ORDER BY b.update_date DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT a.seq ,a.start_date ,a.end_Date ,a.remark ,a.division_code FROM signature a WHERE a.company_code = #{company_code} AND a.seq = ${seq}
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(seq), 0) + 1 FROM signature
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO signature ( seq, company_code, department_code, division_code, start_date, end_date, remark, department_name, signature_name, "position", emp_no, product_line, sign_file_name, sign_file_path, create_date, create_by, update_date, update_by, real_file ) VALUES ( ${seq}, #{company_code}, #{department_code}, #{division_code}, replace(#{start_date},'-', ''), replace(#{end_date},'-', ''), #{remark}, #{department_name}, #{signature_name}, #{position}, #{emp_no}, #{product_line}, #{sign_file_name}, 'DB', NOW(), #{create_by}, NOW(), #{update_by}, #{real_file,jdbcType=BINARY} )
mapper.update: UPDATE signature SET company_code = #{company_code}, department_code = #{department_code}, division_code = #{division_code}, start_date = replace(#{start_date},'-', ''), department_name = #{department_name}, signature_name = #{signature_name}, "position" = #{position}, product_line = #{product_line}, update_date = NOW(), update_by = #{update_by} WHERE seq = ${seq}

SELECT im.item_code, case #{lang} when 'KOR' then im.item_name when 'ENG' then im.item_name_eng end || case when im.spec is null then '' else '/' end || coalesce(im.spec, '') as name_spec, im.hs_code, im.item_desc, im.unit, im.weight, case id.mail_send_yn when 'Y' then 'YES' else 'NO' end as mail_send_yn, case im.process_gubun when 'Y' then 'YES' else 'NO' end as process_gubun, case #{lang} when 'KOR' then cd.code_name when 'ENG' then cd.code_name_eng when 'LOC' then cd.code_name_loc end as assets_type, di.division_code, case #{lang} when 'KOR' then di.division_name when 'ENG' then di.division_name_eng end as division_name, case #{lang} when 'KOR' then pl.product_name when 'ENG' then pl.product_name_eng end as product_name, id.importance_mgt_yn FROM item_mst im JOIN item_dtl id on im.item_code = id.item_code and im.company_code = id.company_code JOIN division di on id.division_code = di.division_code and id.company_code = di.company_code LEFT JOIN product_line pl on im.company_code = pl.company_code and im.product_code = pl.product_code LEFT JOIN code_dtl cd on id.company_code = cd.company_code and id.assets_type = cd.code and cd.category = 'AT' WHERE im.delete_yn = 'N' AND im.company_code = #{company_code}
AND di.division_code = #{search_division_code}
AND (im.hs_code IS NULL OR TRIM(im.hs_code) = '')
AND UPPER(im.item_code) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{serch_keyword}) || '%'
AND ( UPPER(im.item_name) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{serch_keyword}) || '%' OR UPPER(im.item_name_eng) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{serch_keyword}) || '%' )
AND UPPER(im.hs_code) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{serch_keyword}) || '%'
ORDER by im.item_code, di.division_code
SELECT item_code, item_name, weight, unit, product_code, hs_code FROM item_mst WHERE company_code = #{company_code} AND item_code = #{item_code} AND delete_yn = 'N'

SELECT mst.item_code, mst.item_name, mst.weight, mst.unit, mst.product_code, mst.hs_code, dtl.division_code, dtl.assets_type, dtl.po_group, dtl.category1, dtl.category2, dtl.category3, dtl.importance_mgt_yn, dtl.mail_send_yn FROM item_mst mst LEFT OUTER JOIN item_dtl dtl ON mst.company_code = dtl.company_code AND mst.item_code = dtl.item_code AND dtl.delete_yn = 'N' WHERE mst.company_code = #{company_code} AND mst.item_code = #{item_code} AND mst.delete_yn = 'N'
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM hs_code WHERE hs_code = #{hs_code} AND delete_yn = 'N'
SELECT hs_code, hs_code_name, hs_code_name_eng, hs_code_desc FROM hs_code WHERE hs_code = #{hs_code} AND COALESCE(delete_yn, 'N') = 'N'

SELECT item.item_code , item.item_name || '/' || COALESCE(item.spec, '') AS item_name , item.hs_code , nation.code_name AS div_type , fta_hs.fta_hs_code as conv_hs_code FROM fta_hs_code fta_hs INNER JOIN item_mst item ON fta_hs.item_code = item.item_code AND fta_hs.company_code = item.company_code INNER JOIN code_dtl nation ON fta_hs.nation_code = nation.code AND fta_hs.company_code = nation.company_code AND nation.category = 'NA' AND nation.delete_yn = 'N' WHERE fta_hs.company_code = #{company_code} AND fta_hs.item_code = #{item_code} ORDER BY item.item_name , item.hs_code

SELECT DISTINCT item.item_code , item.item_name || '/' || COALESCE(item.spec, '') AS item_name , item.hs_code , fta.fta_name AS div_type , agm_hs.fta_agm_hs_code AS conv_hs_code FROM fta_agm_hs_code agm_hs INNER JOIN item_mst item ON agm_hs.item_code = item.item_code AND agm_hs.company_code = item.company_code INNER JOIN fta_master fta ON agm_hs.fta_code = fta.fta_code WHERE agm_hs.company_code = #{company_code} AND agm_hs.item_code = #{item_code} ORDER BY div_type, conv_hs_code

SELECT cm.company_code , cm.division_code , di.division_name , cm.item_code , im.item_name , im.hs_code , cm.customer_code , cu.customer_name , cm.customer_hs_code , cm.customer_item_code , cm.customer_item_name , cm.customer_standard , cm.remark , TO_CHAR(cm.create_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS create_date , cm.create_by , TO_CHAR(cm.update_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS update_date , cm.update_by FROM customer_model cm LEFT JOIN item_mst im ON cm.company_code = im.company_code AND cm.item_code = im.item_code LEFT JOIN division di ON cm.company_code = di.company_code AND cm.division_code = di.division_code LEFT JOIN customer cu ON cm.company_code = cu.company_code AND cm.customer_code = cu.customer_code WHERE 1 = 1 AND cm.company_code = #{company_code} ORDER BY cm.division_code, cm.item_code, cm.customer_code
